# UI Component Model

## Purpose
The UI Component Model defines entities for reusable UI components.

## Key Entities
- **UIComponent**: Represents a specific UI widget or component.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- UIComponent
    class UIComponent {
        +String name
        +String description
        +String externalId
    }
```
